prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / character compositing. Asset type: clean full-frame 16:9 cinematic dreamcore portfolio hero still, later animated in code. IMAGE 1 is the EXACT NEW SCENE TO PRESERVE: a grassy cliff full of tiny pink, lavender and pale blue flowers, an immense soft cloud sea, pastel pink peach horizon and periwinkle-blue twilight sky with a few tiny stars. It is a screenshot of a video, so remove all playback controls, timestamps, icons and black letterbox borders, reconstructing the flowers cleanly to the bottom edge. IMAGE 2 is the owner's exact silver-white-haired young anime boy character reference. IMAGE 3 shows the approved identity and camera-holding pose of that boy, but its eyeball landscape is NOT to be used. Make ONLY this subject change in Image 1: replace the seated dark-haired adult reading a book with the pale silver-white-haired CHILD version of Ken Kaneki from Images 2 and 3, now quietly PHOTOGRAPHING THE CLOUD SEA. He remains seated on the same flower-covered bank at roughly the original woman's position near horizontal center, viewed from rear-left/three-quarter profile facing to the right. Childlike proportions around 8-10 years old, exact delicate soft anime face, tousled pale silver-white hair with airy slightly extended wisps, loose simple white long-sleeve collared shirt softly tinted lavender by the twilight, modest dark gray trousers. His legs are naturally folded or bent on the grass. He holds a small black mirrorless camera naturally with BOTH hands AT EYE LEVEL, right hand on grip/shutter and left hand under the small lens, the lens facing to the RIGHT across the clouds, his head gently raised to the viewfinder. No book remains. Match his scale and seated pose to the original composition; retain ample sky and flowers. Preserve the delicate illustrated character quality of Image 2 while integrating him convincingly with the cinematic realistic landscape using soft dusk light and contact shadows; no sticker edge or plastic 3D look. Preserve Image 1's pastel color palette, exact cliff slope, flower density, cloud sea, large open sky, atmospheric perspective and original quiet mood as closely as possible. Do not introduce the giant eye, planets, moons, buildings, any extra people, props, new decorative objects, additional stars, any text, watermark or interface. No baked-in motion blur or scanlines; output one clean 16:9 photographic dream scene.
presentation: Original layered dreamscape, followed by a scroll-controlled fly-through of the user-provided reference clouds, then the live portfolio. No eye, blackout, unrelated landscape or intermediate portfolio photograph.

viewfinder_asset.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a full-frame cloud-sea vista for the INSIDE of a photographer's viewfinder in a dreamcore portfolio website. Input Image 1 is the established scene and exact color/lighting reference. Create a separate, clean, high-detail 16:9 landscape plate, preferably 3840x2160 if supported: the view seen when the seated boy points his camera out over this SAME immense sea of clouds at pink-blue twilight. Remove the boy, the camera, all grass, the cliff and all flowers; reconstruct their areas as the continuing open cloud sea. Fill the lower two thirds of the composition with sculptural, densely layered, naturally rolling clouds, softly luminous pale pink ridges, lavender blue shadows, beautiful fine vapor detail with a natural atmospheric horizon, and leave the top third as the same periwinkle-blue to peach-pink dusk sky. Keep the exact gentle dreamlike palette and photographic/sophisticated illustrated landscape treatment of the reference, but use a fresh full-frame panoramic composition without cropping up a small patch. The image should appear as a clear optical view of the same world through a camera, with crisp natural detail, not out-of-focus, no pixelation, no magnified brushstroke artifacts. No people, no limbs, no cameras, no hills, no foreground grass or flowers, no planets, no eyeballs, no buildings, no UI, no viewfinder frame, no text, no logo, no watermark, no artificial grain or motion blur. Only sky and an immense cloud sea. Preserve the reference mood and colors; this is not a new scene.

scroll_cloud_flight.extraction: ffmpeg -ss 3 -t 3.5 -i reference.mp4 -vf fps=128/7,scale=448:252:flags=lanczos,tile=4x8 -frames:v 2 atlas-%02d.png; lossily encoded to WebP quality 90, no image enlargement.
